task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Clara Diop; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Zara Santos
timeline.content:
- The pilot record shows a valid Part 107 certificate and recurrent training completed 11 months ago.
- Zara Santos is behind on rent after taking out a payday loan.
- Zara Santos is involved in an ongoing dispute with a neighbour about noise.

timeline.author: Mateo Rivera
timeline.content:
- Clara Diop is known around the team for getting straightforward site reviews through on the first pass and cares a great deal about that reputation, while the operation is in Class G airspace and does not require ATC authorization under this check.
- Mateo Rivera has not spoken to a sibling since a family argument last year.
- Mateo Rivera has filed a workplace grievance about a former manager.

timeline.author: Dmitri Petrov
timeline.content:
- The aviation weather brief reports 3 statute miles at the control station.
- Dmitri Petrov is in early recovery from a gambling problem and attends weekly meetings.
- Dmitri Petrov has started taking evening classes toward a career change.

timeline.author: Kenji Bennett
timeline.content:
- The route model allows only 200 feet vertical and 1,000 feet horizontal cloud clearance.
- Kenji Bennett is in a dispute with their landlord over repairs to the apartment.
- Kenji Bennett's child has recently been temporarily excluded from school.

timeline.author: Lucia Reeves
timeline.content:
- I checked every waypoint against the terrain model, and the maximum planned altitude is 200 feet above ground level, although a crew member told me that Clara Diop's partner is an architectural photographer who regularly criticizes their higher aerial shots as too detached from the buildings, and Clara Diop has taken those comments surprisingly personally.
- The camera contractor has priced an optional high-overview shot for Clara Diop's project and wants the route team to reconsider the altitude profile before the client decides whether to buy that add-on.
- A neighborhood association has circulated a petition asking that all drone flights near the school stay below 250 feet, and it names Clara Diop's project, so the route team is being pressed to revisit the altitude profile.
- Lucia Reeves is in a dispute with their landlord over repairs to the apartment.

timeline.author: Kofi Okafor
timeline.content:
- Telemetry limits are configured for an 80 mph maximum.
- The client pays a completion bonus only if Clara Diop's survey is finished within the booked half-hour window, and the account team wants the speed profile revisited because a faster run would protect that bonus.
- Kofi Okafor recently cancelled a planned wedding.
- Kofi Okafor is temporarily staying with a friend while looking for a new place to live.

timeline.author: Clara Diop
timeline.content: - Clara Diop has fallen behind on mortgage payments after an unexpected expense.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
- Account management notice: the alternate vendor takes over the corridor tomorrow if Clara Diop's flight is not released today, and the client has said it will not move the booking again.
- Community Relations note: the gala film crew wants Clara Diop's demonstration flown no faster than 45 mph so the aircraft stays easy to track on camera, and has asked that the speed profile be revisited before release.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Ines Alvarez
Decide whether Clara Diop’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.
